quality.review_scope: Two linked source-reported preparations: required solvothermal PbS powder and primary Sample C PbS/carbon-black composite counter electrode, PbS:CB 10:1 by weight. Included product evidence comprises PbS powder phase/size, incoming CB particle-size context, Sample C film morphology/thickness, and the named Sample C symmetric-cell EIS context with 2 M Na2S plus 2 M S. Other ratios, devices, electrolyte variants and stability applications remain explicitly pending. Exact physical batches across preparations and characterization are not established.
missing_fields: Individual PbS and CB masses, CB grade/supplier, PVDF molecular weight/chain and N-methyl pyrrolidone quantity unreported.
Binder preparation conditions, solids-mixing settings and relative order of the two precursor preparations unreported.
Counter-electrode-specific FTO resistance/cleaning/supplier, coating amount/area/passes and blade gap unreported.
Drying atmosphere/ramp and CE storage unreported.
Exact physical batches across synthesis, SEM, profilometry and symmetric-cell EIS are unreported; symmetric-cell spacer thickness unreported.
No atomistic composite model, measured binding geometry or quantitative adhesion strength. QDSC efficiency and sealed-cell stability remain pending device contexts.
